decisions.reason: The flanged dismantling joint sits at the core of the firm's pipeline-component business, uses its existing welding and fabrication capabilities, and has had growing visibility (its own page in 2019), so management stays committed to it.

The powder-coated public waste bin uses the firm's coating equipment and municipal customer base, and it was given its own page as a visible diversification step; management would likely blame weak results on the start-up phase and keep it, though it lies outside the core.

As part of the street-furniture line the firm announced publicly, the waste bin with ashtray shares production and municipal sales channels with D, so management keeps it to justify the earlier diversification decision.

The outdoor public ashtray is the most distant from the firm's core, but it belongs to the same publicly presented coated-products line, and its low marginal cost on existing coating capacity encourages management to persist with it.
